document: DS14360 Rev 6 - Table 64. PLL1/2/3 SSCG parameter ranges
title: Table 64. PLL1/2/3 SSCG parameter ranges
text_helper: Table 64. PLL1/2/3 SSCG parameter ranges — section 6.3.11 PLL characteristics. Parameter, Min, Max.

rows: md: Modulation depth in center spread mode
2*md: Modulation depth in down spread mode
notes: 1. STEP*MOD < 215 then STEP max =215 / MOD min = 32768 / 12.5 = 2621.
2. MOD min = F (VCO_GP) min /4*F max = 2 MHz / 4*40 kHz = 12.5. ref mod
3. MOD max = F (VCO_GP) max /4*F min = 16 MHz / 4*20kHz=200. ref mod
4. As an example, the 20 kHz min limitation comes from JEDEC DDR specification.
